chunks: Whatever is in it from Abū al-Jārūd, I have narrated it from Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī Mājīlawayh—may Allah be pleased with him—from his uncle Muḥammad ibn Abī al-Qāsim, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī al-Qurashī al-Kūfī, from Muḥammad ibn Sinān, from Abū al-Jārūd Ziyād ibn al-Mundhir al-Kūfī.

key_terms.أَبِي الْجَارُودِ: Abū al-Jārūd, the transmitter to whom this chain leads
key_terms.الْقُرَشِيِّ الْكُوفِيِّ: A genealogical and geographical attribution identifying the narrator
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; a statement of direct authorial transmission
key_terms.زِيَادِ بْنِ الْمُنْذِرِ الْكُوفِيِّ: The personal name and attribution of Abū al-Jārūd

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Abū al-Jārūd in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Abū al-Jārūd. Its significance lies in documenting the chain of transmission in hadith scholarship and identifying the intermediaries through whom these narrations are received.
